content: Quinine sulfate, marketed under the brand name QUALAQUIN, is classified as a cinchona alkaloid. Its chemical name is cinchonan-9-ol, 6'-methoxy-, (8α, 9R)-, sulfate (2:1) (salt), dihydrate. The molecular formula of quinine sulfate is (C20H24N2O2)2H2SO42H2O, and its molecular weight is 782.96. Quinine sulfate appears as a white, crystalline powder that tends to darken when exposed to light. It is odorless but has a distinctly persistent and very bitter taste. The compound exhibits limited solubility in water, alcohol, chloroform, and ether. QUALAQUIN is formulated for oral administration and is available in capsule form. Each capsule contains 324 mg of quinine sulfate USP, which is equivalent to 269 mg of the free base form of quinine. The inactive ingredients in the formulation include corn starch, magnesium stearate, and talc.
